name: --sk-color-bg-page
description: Page background.

name: --sk-color-bg-surface
description: Flat surfaces on the page, such as cards and panels. The same white as raised, without the shadow.

name: --sk-color-bg-raised
description: Surfaces that float above the page: popovers, menus, the prompt bar. Pair with shadow-raised.

name: --sk-color-bg-sunken
description: Wells set into a surface, such as a code block.

name: --sk-color-bg-hover
description: Fill behind a transparent row or control under the pointer.

name: --sk-color-bg-active
description: Fill behind a transparent row or control while pressed or selected.

name: --sk-color-bg-overlay
description: Scrim behind modal layers.

name: --sk-color-text-primary
description: Default text and icons: labels, typed input.

name: --sk-color-text-secondary

diverges.reason: The sampled grey #767587 measured 4.21:1 on bg-page and 3.99:1 on bg-hover, below 4.5:1 for text.

description: Supporting text and icons: descriptions, hints, toolbar icons. At least 4.5:1 on every background fill.

name: --sk-color-text-disabled

contrast.exempt: Disabled controls are exempt from WCAG 1.4.3.

description: Text and icons of disabled controls.

name: --sk-color-text-inverse
description: Text and icons on dark fills.

name: --sk-color-text-on-accent
description: Text and icons on accent-solid. White measures only 2.66:1 there.

name: --sk-color-border-separator
description: Lines that divide content, such as the rule above a hint.

name: --sk-color-border-subtle
description: Hairline edge of raised surfaces. The ring inside shadow-raised uses the same colour.

name: --sk-color-border-default

contrast.exempt: Decoration: the control keeps another visible edge. Use border-strong when the border is the only one.

description: Borders that enclose a control where the border is decoration, not its only edge.

name: --sk-color-border-strong
description: Borders that are the only visible edge of a control. At least 3:1 on page, surface and raised.

name: --sk-color-border-focus
description: Focus indicators. At least 3:1 on page, surface and raised.

name: --sk-color-accent-solid

contrast.exempt: The glyph identifies the control, and text-on-accent carries its contrast on the fill.
The glyph identifies the control, and text-on-accent carries its contrast on the fill.

description: The one filled primary action in a view, such as send.

name: --sk-color-accent-solid-hover
description: accent-solid under the pointer. text-on-accent stays at least 4.5:1 on it.

name: --sk-color-accent-subtle
description: Tinted background for selected or highlighted items.

name: --sk-color-accent-border
description: Border of accent-tinted items.

name: --sk-color-accent-text
description: Accent text and icons, such as links. At least 4.5:1 on page, surface, raised and accent-subtle.

name: --sk-font-family-base
description: The UI typeface. Load Figtree in the app; without it, text falls back to system-ui.

name: --sk-font-label-md
description: Labels and item titles. 14px on a 16px line box.

name: --sk-font-label-sm
description: Compact control labels, such as a model picker. 12px on a 16px line box.

name: --sk-font-body-md
description: Descriptions and body text. 14px on a 16px line box.

name: --sk-font-body-sm
description: Hints and helper text. 12px on a 16px line box.

name: --sk-font-input-md
description: Typed input text. 14px on a 28px line box, the height of size-control-sm.

name: --sk-space-gap-xs
description: Tight gap between a label and its glyph, such as a chevron.

name: --sk-space-gap-sm
description: Default gap between items in a row or a stack.

name: --sk-space-inset-sm
description: Padding inside surfaces and around lists.

name: --sk-space-inset-lg
description: Padding for text set directly against a surface edge, such as a hint.

name: --sk-size-icon-sm
description: Small glyphs beside text, such as a chevron.

name: --sk-size-icon-md
description: Default icon size.

name: --sk-size-control-sm
description: Icon buttons and single-line rows.

name: --sk-size-control-lg
description: Large input containers, such as the prompt bar.

name: --sk-radius-lg
description: Raised surfaces such as popovers.

name: --sk-radius-pill
description: Pills: controls and bars with fully round ends, such as the prompt bar. Only the sharp radius scale squares them off.

name: --sk-radius-circle
description: Circles: square controls and avatars, such as icon buttons. Round on every radius scale.

name: --sk-border-width-default
description: Hairline borders and separators.

name: --sk-shadow-raised
description: Elevation for raised surfaces: the Figma effect style shadow. Six soft layers and a 1px ring, in CSS paint order.

name: --sk-motion-duration-fast
description: Small elements, such as a tooltip appearing or a chip dismissing.

name: --sk-motion-duration-normal
description: The default, such as a dropdown opening or a focus ring.

name: --sk-motion-duration-moderate
description: Medium elements, such as a dialog entering or a panel sliding in.

name: --sk-motion-easing-standard
description: Elements changing state or moving within the view.

name: --sk-motion-easing-enter
description: Elements entering the view.

name: --sk-motion-easing-exit
description: Elements leaving the view.
